text: Risk management is the process of identifying possible problems before they happen. First, you need to identify risks by thinking about what could go wrong in a project or business. After that, you develop mitigation strategies to reduce the chance or impact of those risks. For example, you might train staff or buy insurance. It is also wise to create contingency plans, which are backup plans in case something fails. Finally, monitoring is essential because risks can change over time. By checking regularly, you can spot new dangers early and take action quickly. Good risk management helps you stay calm and prepared.
